description: For a table-type, a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over B: read CacheSize and CacheStart, assign CacheSize 10 and read it. Then on one dynaset assign each CacheSize [Long 0 ;; Long 1 ;; Long 4 ;; Long 5 ;; Long 6 ;; Long 100 ;; Long 1200 ;; Long 1201 ;; Long -1 ;; "10" ;; Double 10.5 ;; Null] and read CacheSize and CacheStart after each, and read ID. Asks which types have the properties, the default, and the accepted range, coercion and refusals of CacheSize. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
